name: io.github.notadeviamameatpopsicle/youandeye
title: YouAndEye
description: Drive a physical expressive face over MCP. Semantic affects, bounded identity profiles, and self-timed multi-beat performances on dual round IPS eyes and an optional round AMOLED mouth.

environmentVariables.name: YOUANDEYE_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Explicit serial port, or 'auto' for safe single-device discovery.

environmentVariables.name: YOUANDEYE_AMOLED_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Discover the optional round mouth, or 'off' to force the built-in OLED.

environmentVariables.name: YOUANDEYE_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Stable identity used to select a local profile.
